remainingPorts.requirement: Generate/validate actual stable IDs, geometry/topology/render roots and versioned manifest; adapt the approved artifacts to WorldGeometryCatalogContract. Synthetic catalog IDs are format fixtures only.

Create complete production one-to-many TerritoryMigrationEntry mapping and implement CanonicalTerritoryCoverageValidator against locked P0/derived-P0 bytes, catalog roots and source-country coverage. Prove gap/overlap/cross-border rejection on the whole production input.
Supply every actual active country color from existing seed/projection state, including dynamically created countries; preserve RGB values while canonicalizing hex case.
Adapt commands/planners/effect compiler, strict API/context contracts and reference rewrite paths to catalog IDs and the migrated schema pair; avoid geometry in mutable state.
Connect chosen delivery to projection, selection, hover, labels, search and panels using RenderFeatureRef and catalog indexes; use affected features only.
Integrate authoritative V3/V2 content and catalog-ref hashing into affected mutation paths. Offline checkpoint hashes are full validation hashes and must not become ordinary camera/update work.

Connect the validated V3 world port to the real store/application runtime with pair preflight/publication, history and undo/redo; replace legacy snapshot restoration and persistence helper contracts at the single cutover.

Atomically switch seed/server/browser authority to World V3 / Simulation V2 only after REVIEW C and consumer readiness; validate catalog mismatch/readiness failures and keep refresh at the canonical 2020-01-01 seed without browser persistence.

Create validated bounded turn authority, enforce effect authorization and expiry/merge/dissolve lifecycle events, and integrate occupation/color changes and undo/redo. Synthetic checkpoint state transitions do not implement these planners.
